subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Raven Steals the Sun
description: Learn Raven Steals the Sun in one minute.

hook.text: In Northwest Coast myths, the world was dark until Raven stole the sun from a chief who kept it hidden.

buildup.text: Raven transformed into a pine needle, was swallowed by the chief's daughter, and was reborn as a baby.

discovery.text: As a child, he cried until the chief let him play with the glowing box. Then Raven flew away with the sun.

twist.text: Raven didn't steal light for humanity's sake. He was greedy and curious. The benefit to humans was accidental.

climax.text: Raven embodies the trickster paradox: selfish acts with selfless outcomes. Good deeds from bad motives.

punchline.text: He lit the world by accident.

quiz.question: How did Raven gain access to the sun in Northwest Coast myth?
options: He was reborn as the chief's grandchild
